checks.title: Label contradiction
checks.summary: The listing states alkaline, but the product is marked R6 (IEC designation for zinc-carbon) and R03 (IEC designation for zinc-carbon) and 'Heavy Duty' (a carbon-zinc grade name). The listing text and the product markings disagree.

constants.description: R6 designates a zinc-carbon AA cell
constants.quote: AA SUPER HEAVY DUTY; Chemical System: Zinc-Manganese Dioxide (Zn/MnO2); Designation: ANSI-15D, IEC-R6; Battery Voltage: 1.5 Volts

constants.description: LR03 designates an alkaline AAA cell
constants.source_title: Energizer EN92 product datasheet, form no. EN92EU0126
constants.locator: Specifications block and industry standard dimensions drawing
constants.quote: Classification: Alkaline; Designation: ANSI-24A, IEC-LR03; Nominal Voltage: 1.5 volts; Shelf Life: 10 years at 21°C; 10.50 / 44.50 mm maximum

constants.description: Grade names used for carbon-zinc cells
constants.source_title: Eveready Carbon Zinc Battery Handbook and Application Manual
constants.quote: Eveready Carbon Zinc batteries are marketed in three basic grades—General Purpose, Heavy Duty and Super Heavy Duty.

notes: IEC designations: no letter before R means zinc-carbon (R6, R03); L means alkaline (LR6, LR03); H means NiMH (HR6, HR03). Source: IEC 60086-1 letter codes.
